reason: The supplied parser guards reject array and object nesting at the new object printer’s threshold. The complete parse_value body is missing, so the packet does not establish whether a parser-produced object can reach printing at a depth the printer rejects. The harness does not assert that printing succeeds.

scope_contract.reason: The target parses input and prints the returned tree, so printing a parser-produced object is within its operational surface.

feasible_trigger.reason: The supplied object and array parsers reject containers at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT, matching the printer’s guard. Without parse_value, no finite input is shown to produce an accepted object at the rejected printing depth.

evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing rejects nesting at the printer’s threshold.
Array parsing applies the same threshold to mixed nesting.

observable_consequence.reason: If such a tree existed, the guard would make printing return NULL. Its reachability is unproved, and the harness only frees a non-NULL result; it has no existing success assertion.

evidence.dependency_reason: An unbuffered print failure propagates to the NULL return at lines 1285–1299.
The unbuffered printer returns NULL after a print failure.
The buffered printer also returns NULL after a print failure.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: For a parser-returned tree at a rejected depth, all three printing choices reach print_value and its object dispatch. The supplied parser guards are counterevidence to the trigger, rather than an alternative printing route.

evidence.dependency_reason: The shared unbuffered printer calls print_value.
print_value dispatches object values to print_object.

identity_preserved.reason: The same parse-then-print tuple and old harness are assessed before and after. The old object printer has no depth guard; the new one does. That difference alone does not establish a reachable blocker.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing uses the same nesting threshold.
Array parsing uses the same nesting threshold.

missing_information: Complete before and after cJSON.c::parse_value bodies, to establish every route that constructs a parser-produced object.
The compiled definition of CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT, if a finite depth witness becomes possible.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a parser-produced object at a depth accepted by parsing.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid input whose parsed object reaches a depth rejected by print_object; existence is unproved.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness prints only the tree returned by cJSON_ParseWithOpts.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Successful printing at that accepted depth, if such a parser-produced tree exists.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: Buffered, formatted, and unformatted printing all reach print_value and print_object; none bypasses the depth guard.
